# registry_terraform_mirror_version (Data Source)

Reads details for a single mirrored Terraform/OpenTofu version including available platforms.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_terraform_mirror_version" "tofu" {
  mirror_id = registry_terraform_mirror.opentofu.id
  version   = "1.10.0"
}

output "tofu_platforms" {
  value = [for p in data.registry_terraform_mirror_version.tofu.platforms : "${p.os}/${p.arch}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mirror_id` (String) UUID of the Terraform mirror configuration.
- `version` (String) Semantic version string to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal UUID of the version record.
- `platforms` (Attributes List) Available platform builds for this version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--platforms))
- `stable` (Boolean) Whether this is a stable release.
- `synced_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when this version was synced.

<a id="nestedatt--platforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `platforms`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String) Architecture (e.g. 'amd64', 'arm64').
- `os` (String) Operating system (e.g. 'linux', 'darwin').
- `url` (String) Download URL for this platform binary.
